I came to this establishment because I was on a time crunch and saw good reviews, but I left a bit disappointed. The staff were very friendly and accommodating, and the prices were fair, which I appreciated. The woman who did my nails was …

My first visit here and got acrylic powder overlay on my nails and a pedicure. I liked how my nails turned out. They lasted during my vacation. Emma did my hands, and the older gentleman did my feet. The place was clean and accommodating. Pricing is fair. I will come back here again.
